display_long_description:
Short Description (≤500 characters):
Surgical Technology is a VR training app developed as part of the Immerse Learn Surgical Technology Certification Program. Available exclusively to enrolled students, it provides hands-on practice in surgical procedures, instrument handling, sterile techniques, and operating room protocols within a realistic virtual environment.

Long Description (≤1000 characters):
Surgical Technology is part of the Immerse Learn Surgical Technology Certification Program and is accessible only to students enrolled in the program. This immersive VR simulation delivers realistic, hands-on training in essential surgical technology skills and operating room procedures. Learners can practice sterile techniques, surgical instrument identification and handling, operating room preparation, and workflow coordination in a safe, interactive environment. Designed to align with industry and educational standards, the app helps students strengthen technical accuracy, safety compliance, and confidence before entering real-world clinical settings. Surgical Technology provides a risk-free space for developing critical perioperative skills and improving procedural knowledge through experiential learning. 

Access to this application is restricted to students enrolled in the certification program for their hands-on training.
